findings.title: The no-echo configuration test survives leaking the complete configured value
findings.reason: The credential-bearing invalid-origin case has a green baseline. Removing credential rejection was killed, but a second one-line mutant appending raw ADMIN_APP_URL to the stable Error message passed the same individual case. The test only asserts a message substring and never checks that the configured value is absent. Production at the pinned HEAD currently uses a fixed redacted message; this finding is a demonstrated missing test oracle, not an existing production disclosure.
findings.arbiter_reasoning: The fixture supplies an HTTP(S) origin with username/password. It passes the initial origin-shape check and executes the credential guard, which calls invalid(). Appending raw to the Error message therefore changes the observable thrown message on the branch this exact test executes, exposing the credential-bearing fixture. The original and mutant messages differ semantically; this is not an equivalent mutation or an unexecuted branch. Vitest reports exactly one executed passing test because toThrow(string) accepts a substring. Assert the exact safe message (or capture the Error and explicitly reject the raw value) to enforce the claimed no-echo behavior.

findings.title: The Admin URL configuration failure lacks a documented alert mapping
findings.reason: Missing or invalid ADMIN_APP_URL introduces a request-fatal configuration error on Admin redirects and server renders. Existing src/instrumentation.ts:9 captures request errors, but docs/runbooks/beta-launch-alerting.md contains no mapping for this new signal to an alert filter, grouping, cadence, and operator destination/action. Generic high-priority rule discussion is not a six-facet mapping for this error. This is a static documentation/alert-path gap; actual production delivery was not tested and is not claimed absent.
